title: Melatonin vs placebo for sleep-onset latency in primary insomnia
question: In adults with primary insomnia, does melatonin reduce sleep-onset latency versus placebo? (Randomized placebo-controlled trials; mean difference in minutes.)
pubmed_queries: melatonin primary insomnia sleep onset latency placebo randomized
"melatonin"[Title] AND "primary insomnia" AND placebo AND randomized
"prolonged-release melatonin" insomnia placebo randomized sleep latency

primary_outcome.name: Sleep-onset latency
primary_outcome.population: adults with primary insomnia (the full eligible population)

population_default.subgroups: separate analyses (age bands, low excretors); never the primary input and never pooled as independent of their own trial
population_default.overrides: protocol line 26, which made Wade's pre-specified age 65-80 subgroup the pooled input
population_default.decided: 2026-09-27, melatonin review; decided by Dispatch under Mahmood's delegation. RETROSPECTIVE: made after registration and after the results were seen, so it is not demonstrably prospective.

measurement_classes.rule: sleep-onset latency by polysomnography, by sleep diary and by questionnaire (e.g. PSQI question 2) are different measurements: a separate analysis per class, never one chosen for favourability or convenience
measurement_classes.primary_note: no primary measurement class is declared; the decision did not name one
measurement_classes.decided: 2026-09-27, melatonin review; decided by Dispatch under Mahmood's delegation. RETROSPECTIVE: made after registration and after the results were seen, so it is not demonstrably prospective.

primary.protocol_quote: The pooled value is the unadjusted per-arm mean difference computed from the reported per-arm change-from-baseline means and SDs; the trial's own covariate-adjusted estimate ... is noted where it differs.

sensitivity.rule: reported adjusted differences, kept separate from raw ones; SE only when established
sensitivity.registration: 2026-09-27, melatonin review; decided by Dispatch under Mahmood's delegation. RETROSPECTIVE: made after registration and after the results were seen, so it is not demonstrably prospective.

eligibility_summary: Double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs in adults with primary insomnia or insomnia symptoms where melatonin is compared with placebo. Eligibility is on P/I/C/design only; outcome reporting is extraction status.
